ideas.pitch: A smart school administration and attendance integration tool inspired by Code-X-Novas's own product ecosystem, combining smart attendance logging with real-time student sentiment feedback loops.
ideas.title: VidyaOS Automated Attendance and Feedback Intelligence
ideas.why_it_could_win: Code-X-Novas organizes the hackathon and focuses heavily on education technology platforms like VidyaOS 360 and SAS 360; aligning the project directly with their core business domain provides an immediate strategic advantage with judges.

ideas.pitch: A visual workflow orchestration engine that monitors automated school administrative processes and flags compliance and operational risks before deployment across institutional networks.
ideas.title: BPMN-Orchestrated EdTech Risk Workflow
ideas.why_it_could_win: Mirrors the architectural rigor of UiPath AgentHack winners by using BPMN orchestration for practical enterprise and institutional risk management.

ideas.pitch: A training-free semantic router that classifies student and institutional support queries, routing them to appropriate automated workflows while self-improving via LLM-judge feedback loops.
ideas.title: Self-Improving Semantic Routing for EdTech Support
ideas.why_it_could_win: Adapts the proven architecture of the Superlinked x Qwen Hackathon winner into the educational domain, demonstrating hard engineering in routing and prompt optimization.

ideas.pitch: Two specialized business intelligence agents simulating client-vendor negotiations over service-level agreements to stress-test enterprise contracts before human deployment.
ideas.title: Adversarial Business Intelligence Negotiation Agent
ideas.why_it_could_win: Uses the complex multi-agent adversarial dynamic seen in the Datadog Self-Improving Agents Hack winner, showcasing advanced autonomous agent behavior.

ideas.pitch: A local developer tool that reviews student codebase submissions for security flaws and performance bottlenecks completely offline using hardware-accelerated NPUs.
ideas.title: Offline-First NPU Code Reviewer for Student Projects
ideas.why_it_could_win: Follows the hardware-adjacent, local-first utility pattern of the Qualcomm Snapdragon Multiverse runner-up, focusing on practical developer tooling.
